_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Directory lookup failures are visible and can be retried. Conversation {{ID}} runs in {{DIR}}, an empty directory that is not a git repository, and is archived; another conversation is in the list. Call "break lookups" makes the server's directory lookups (GET /api/list-directory) fail with HTTP 503 "Directory lookup unavailable"; call "fix lookups" lets them through again. To "start a new conversation": wait for ".header" to be visible; if the button in ".header" whose accessible name is exactly "New Conversation" is visible, click it; otherwise click the button in ".header" named exactly "More options", then the button named exactly "New Conversation" in ".chat-overflow-popover". "The directory control" on this phone-sized screen is the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory"; to reach it, click the button named exactly "More options" first unless ".chat-overflow-popover" is already visible. Call "saved" reports the first message the page sends: "none" before it, then "ok cwd=<the conversation's saved working directory> draft=<whether it is still a draft>". To "send P and expect cwd C": fill [data-testid="message-input"] with P; call "saved", which must return exactly "none"; click [data-testid="send-button"]; then call "saved" until it returns exactly "ok cwd=C draft=false". To "check and send in C": the directory control's text should contain C; press Escape; then send "echo: new conversation directory" and expect cwd C. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. Call "break lookups". 3. Start a new conversation. 4. The element with role "alert" should contain the text "Directory lookup unavailable". 5. The page must not have gone to /new: eval /\/new$/.test(location.href) must give false. 6. Call "fix lookups". 7. Click the button named "Dismiss" inside the alert. 8. Start a new conversation. 9. Check and send in {{DIR}}.
